title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931: Ramat Rahel
author: (round-up; excavation supervised by B. Maisler with M. Stekelis)
location_note: Between Talpiyot and Giv'at Eliyahu (Khirbat Salih); the text gives the P.E.F. map square XVII M t only; placed by name.
notes: Jan.-Mar. 1931, Jewish Palestine Exploration Society: rock-hewn tomb with courtyard and niche, ossuary chamber (five kokhim, several ossuaries, rosette decoration) and bone chamber (six kokhim); a woman's burial in a hollow in the court; Iron II-III and Hellenistic pottery and a Proto-Aeolic-style capital among the finds.

features.subtype: rock-hewn kokhim tomb: courtyard with niche, ossuary chamber (5 kokhim, ossuaries) and bone chamber (6 kokhim), stone doors
features.period: eleven skeletons with pottery of the first century BC
features.quote: eleven skeletons were found in the ossuary chamber with various pottery

features.period: later than the tomb; contained Hellenistic pottery and an Iron II figurine head
features.quote: A later winepress, built of cement, was opposite
